sloka: पुरस्य चाकरोन्नाम मधुमन्तमिति प्रभो ।पुरोहितं तूशनसं वरयामास सुव्रतम् ।। ७.७९.१८ ॥
transliteration: purasya cākaronnāma madhumantamiti prabho ।purohitaṁ tūśanasaṁ varayāmāsa suvratam ।। 7.79.18 ॥

translations.english: And, O Lord, he named the city Madhumanta and indeed chose the righteous Ushanas as his priest.
